description:
[Trading Data API] Recent forced liquidations on OKX USDT perpetual swaps for a coin: each event with time, liquidated side, bankruptcy price, size and USD notional, plus long vs short liquidated totals and the largest event. Real exchange data, no estimates.

**Example:** `/v1/liquidations?coin=ETH&limit=50`

Use when you want recent forced liquidations on OKX USDT perpetuals for a coin, with side and size. Not for liquidity pools (use liquidity_levels).

Behavior: read-only. Priced via x402 (USDC on Base) or free with WICKEDAPI_API_KEY; with neither, you get HTTP 402 with the decoded price in payment_required (a price quote, not a failure).

coin.description: Optional. Ticker such as BTC (default), ETH, SOL.

name: liquidations
